correctness.rationale: All-graph proof reconstructs independent/shared/disjoint Bernoulli edge-pair laws, obtains Cov(Y)=(I+B^T B)/12, then Sigma=(Q+Q²)/12; PSD Q implies the exact principal-square-root inverse. The Sylvester spectral-separation argument gives the Frobenius constant 12, and all boundary cases including empty hosts follow. Exact-rational verification independently compares direct edge-pair sums and polynomial covariance for every simple graph of order at most five (1,099 hosts).

value.rationale: The exact covariance map identifies the full labeled topology of any unknown host from replicated vertex degrees alone; marginal means supply only host degrees. The explicit principal-root inverse is stable (Frobenius constant 12), supports deterministic exact edge recovery under a quantitative covariance error condition, and implies almost-sure recovery for repeated independent observations. It characterizes all nonzero covariance modes and detects bipartite components from nullity. This is a complete motivated inverse result for a natural correlated-edge network model, not arbitrary small-count computation.
